sloka: इयं पुनरसम्भ्रान्ता निरुद्विग्ना तरस्विनी ।सेना रक्षति काकुत्स्थौ मया प्रीत्या निवेदितौ ।। ६.४८.२८ ।।।।
transliteration: iyaṁ punarasambhrāntā nirudvignā tarasvinī ।senā rakṣati kākutsthau mayā prītyā niveditau ।। 6.48.28 ।।।।

translations.english: "This army is not doubting, not perturbed also, that they are killed. They are guarding the Kakutsthas lovingly. I am telling you."
